notes:
Priority: real-time agent assist for voice & chat. Customer runs multiregional contact centers (NA + EU). Key ask: streaming, low-latency suggestions surfaced in agent UI with strong guardrails so agents never leak PII. Interested in Redwood we can route by region and fall back to smaller models during spikes.

POC quote from CTO: "If suggestions add latency >50ms perceived by agent we see drop-off. We need p99 streaming <75ms and best-effort sub-50ms UI hinting."

Security: SOC2 in place, customer requires SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs, and data residency for EU customers. PCI in-scope for payments flows; legal asked about live redaction and tool-calling isolation (tool calls must not send full card numbers to 3rd party models).

Cost sensitivity: cost per agent per month target to scale to 1k+ agents. Open to Dedicated or Private for predictable unit economics but will pilot hosted for speed.

Guardrails/QA: need built-in prompt/response filters, hallucination mitigation via retrieval + reranker, and an eval harness tied to ticket-level quality metrics. Requesting Redwood Optimize recommendations on quantization + batching for streaming.

POC success criteria:
- sustain 250 concurrent streaming agents with stable suggestion latency (p50 < 20ms, p95 < 45ms, p99 < 75ms)
- suggestion relevance hit-rate > 68% measured on agent feedback within 2 weeks
- end-to-end tool-calls (CRM action) with guaranteed scrub/redaction layer and audit trail

Notes from sales call 2026-02-28: AE demoed streaming assistant; SE suggested dedicated GPU pool + prefix caching and KV offload for long contexts. Customer asked about automatic fallback to smaller model under severe contention. They also requested pricing scenario for bursty seasonal spikes (Black Friday-like loads).
